page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.7xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 32 vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, supported by two threads per core and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. It features 64 GB of system RAM, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware vector acceleration is available via AVX and AVX-512F instructions, alongside AES cryptography support. The server includes no bundled local storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring administrators to rely entirely on external network-attached volumes for persistent data.

Benchmark results demonstrate a clear divide between single-thread efficiency and aggregate multi-core capability. Single-core performance registers in the lower quartile, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 910.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 1099.89. Single-threaded compression throughput is similarly constrained. Conversely, parallel execution leverages the full 32 virtual cores to achieve average multi-core throughput, reflected in a Geekbench multi-core score of 8155.0, a PassMark CPU score of 27781.64, and 84.17 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory performance exhibits strong cached transfer rates at 1670.44 GB/sec for small blocks, though uncached large-block writes measure at 47.18 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.n1.7xlarge instance offers competitive multi-threaded compute density per resource unit when running tasks that scale linearly across many cores. However, the older Intel architecture provides diminished value for workloads reliant on per-core clock speed or modern vector extensions like VNNI and AMX. The instance is suited for multi-threaded batch processing, Clang software builds, distributed static web serving, and parallel worker queues that require high core counts without demanding massive memory capacities or high single-thread responsiveness.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.7xlarge is a compute-focused x86_64 instance featuring 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 64 GB of RAM, it maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio suitable for moderately memory-intensive compute tasks. The instance includes no onboard local storage and no hardware GPUs, requiring external block storage for operation. Benchmark metrics highlight lower-tier single-threaded compute metrics contrasted with solid, mid-tier multi-threaded execution across 32 threads, as seen in balanced Clang compilation and multi-core compression tests. This profile makes the instance well-suited for parallelized compilation pipelines, static web serving clusters, and distributed batch processing.
